scene: Day 17, grey daylight at a water-treatment plant. Seen from above: a huge rectangular concrete basin full of dark green water, crowded with green walkers standing waist-deep, all looking up, arms raised against the smooth wall that they cannot climb. On the narrow concrete edge between two basins, Patch (round white head, black dot eyes, orange bandage on the forehead, orange backpack) walks with his arms out for balance, eyes huge, one sweat drop, close to the camera, water on both sides. Behind him, Ines (round white head, bright yellow hooded raincoat, big wrench in hand) waves him forward. Tense because one step to either side and he falls in with them.

Inside a glass control booth high above a water-treatment plant at dawn. Patch (round white head, orange bandage on the forehead, orange backpack) presses both mitten hands and his face against the glass, eyes wide, mouth a small O. Ines (yellow hooded raincoat) holds a small handheld radio up to her ear beside him. Through the glass below: four big concrete basins full of green walkers, a closed metal sliding gate, and the inlet canal completely dry, with a line of boot prints in the mud. The glass is covered with hand-written tally marks in black marker. Tense because the water has stopped and a stranger is on the radio.
